t.E1103.agn: In 2001 JECFA found invertase obtained from the yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae and meeting the specifications acceptable, noting that this yeast is widely used in food preparation; it recommended that its use be limited by good manufacturing practice.
t.E1103.found.0: Additive and carrier in nutrient preparations such as vitamins and minerals
t.E1103.regx.0: Invertase from yeast acceptable; use limited by good manufacturing practice.
t.E1103.summary: An enzyme that splits sugar into glucose and fructose. It is used in soft-centred confectionery and in the production of invert sugar.
t.E1103.what: An enzyme that splits sucrose into glucose and fructose (beta-fructofuranosidase).
